## ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​Broward County's Small Business Micro-Grant Pilot ​​​Program

​


![Logo ](https://www.broward.org/EconDev/SiteAssets/Pages/Small-Business-Micro-Grant/Logo%20resized%20for%20website.png)

## ​​Program Overv​iew​​​

The Office of Economic and Small Business Development (OESBD) administers a Small Business Micro-Grant Pilot Program to provide working capital for small businesses located within Broward County. The pilot program is intended to assist the smallest of Broward businesses that need financial assistance. The application process is online and qualified applications will be reviewed by OESBD. Qualifying applicants​ can apply for $5,000 or $2,500 in reimbursable expenses for their small business for eligible expenses paid within 180 days prior to their application date.​

​

## Eligibility Requirements​

- Business is currently eligible (meaning they are NOT suspended or debarred) to contract with the federal, state, or local government to receive federal, state, or local grants or loans.​

- Registered with a Broward Cou​​nty Business License Tax Receipt (2025 or 2026)

- Registered with a City Business License Tax Receipt (2025 or 2026)

- ​Have been in operation on or before October 1, 2024

- Registered with State of Florida Division of Corporations

- ​Business Tax Filings must be current (2024 or 2025)​

- Business Gross Annual Revenue of $1,000,000 or less

- Business Employs 20 full-time people or less

- The applicant(s) must be a majority owner or combined majority owners of the business (50% or more)

- Must be a for-profit business

- Must not be part of a national chain

- Grant eligibility will be based on the address of the business as reported in the application; the home address of a business owner will not be considered unless the business is operating as a home-based business (home-based businesses must submit copy of IRS Form 8829)

- ​One application per business, regardless of total eligible expenses.


## ​​​​Eligi​ble Expenses

• Purchase of Inventory and Supplies (excludes alcoholic beverages, cigarettes, tobacco, etc.)

• Business Equipment

• Payment of rent or mortgage of the ​commercial space (home-based businesses must submit copy of IRS Form 8829)

• Publicity, Marketing, and Advertising (signs, pamphlets, wall plaques, cornerstones, dedications, notices, flyers, brochures, news releases, media, packages, promotions, and/or stationery)

• Commercial Security Systems

• Commercial Liability Insurance

• Professional Services (services must be directly provided to the business, i.e. Legal Services in connection with operation of the business).

•Eligible expenses as identified above that were paid for with a credit card under the business name (All receipts MUST be under the

business name)​​

These types of businesses are NOT eligible: any private or commercial golf course, country club, massage parlor, adult entertainment, hot​​ tub facility, suntan facility, racetrack or other facility used for gambling, or any store which the principal business is the sale of alcoholic beverages, tobacco, or other drug for consumption off premises.​​​

## ​Prohibited Expe​​​nse​​​s​

- Purchase of alcohol or tobacco​

- Purchase or lease of work vehicle

- Rental deposits for a new business space

- Late payment fees

- Debts

- Payroll/Salaries

- Pre-Paid Expenses (such as insurance)

- Taxes

- ​Interior/Exterior Renovations​ and all home improvements

- Fees owed to Broward County

- Utility Bills​​

- Art

- Travel

- Home Insurance

- Car insurance for personal vehicle

- ​All others not listed in the eligible use list​

​​

## FAQS

[**How will I be notified if I am selected?**](https://www.broward.org/EconDev/Pages/small-business-micro-grant.aspx#Info0566c8fc-8807-4c9b-a6b9-60d449d66873 "How will I be notified if I am selected?")

a. You will receive an Approval Email at the email address provided in your application.

Last modified: 3/8/2024

[**When would I receive payment?**](https://www.broward.org/EconDev/Pages/small-business-micro-grant.aspx#Info825fd181-f525-440b-bbf8-352041e0fb64 "When would I receive payment?")

a. Once approved, payments are expected to be processed within 4 weeks of “Payment Processing" notification.​

Last modified: 8/16/2024

[**How can I check the status of my application?**](https://www.broward.org/EconDev/Pages/small-business-micro-grant.aspx#Info8ad27aa3-bd5e-4e3d-8806-bcf2e3acb2ff "How can I check the status of my application?")

​a. Log in to your Access Broward account and view the status of your application.

Last modified: 3/8/2024

[**Who can I contact with questions about the forms and required supporting documentation?**](https://www.broward.org/EconDev/Pages/small-business-micro-grant.aspx#Info374b1f2d-6c70-46a2-b3f4-b2eff3a42bde "Who can I contact with questions about the forms and required supporting documentation?")

a. Office of Economic and Small Business Development at 954-​357-6400.​

Last modified: 8/16/2024

[**Does the application come in Spanish and Creole?**](https://www.broward.org/EconDev/Pages/small-business-micro-grant.aspx#Info8375092f-537e-4cc8-a3cf-324d1d7c6fa6 "Does the application come in Spanish and Creole?")

a. No

Last modified: 3/8/2024

[**Do you provide technical assistance in Spanish and Creole?**](https://www.broward.org/EconDev/Pages/small-business-micro-grant.aspx#Infofcb91696-46d5-4403-8a51-6db789a36f07 "Do you provide technical assistance in Spanish and Creole?")

​a. Yes, contact OESBD at 954-357-6400 for assistance.

Last modified: 4/25/2024

[**Based on the services that I provide, I’m not sure if my business is eligible to receive grant funding? Who can I contact to confirm if it is?**](https://www.broward.org/EconDev/Pages/small-business-micro-grant.aspx#Infob43b39bc-b4a8-484d-b47a-8c8ec9d548df "Based on the services that I provide, I’m not sure if my business is eligible to receive grant funding? Who can I contact to confirm if it is?")

a. Office of Economic and Small Business Development at 954-357-6400​​

Last modified: 3/8/2024

[**What if I have no employees? It is just me. Could I still qualify for funding?**](https://www.broward.org/EconDev/Pages/small-business-micro-grant.aspx#Info815bfa14-77c0-44d5-8cd8-6338a4c57ddd "What if I have no employees? It is just me. Could I still qualify for funding?")

a. Yes

Last modified: 3/8/2024

[**What dates will the application be open?**](https://www.broward.org/EconDev/Pages/small-business-micro-grant.aspx#Info54d97d8c-30fc-4f83-a96e-fab12b3fcaa5 "What dates will the application be open?")

The 2025 application is now closed.

Stay tuned for OESBD announcements for the 2026 micro-grant cycle.

Last modified: 9/22/2025

[**I am missing one or more of the required documents as part of the application, am I still eligible for funding?**](https://www.broward.org/EconDev/Pages/small-business-micro-grant.aspx#Info07dc7b03-5be5-4e00-b7b1-8fa15ce8883a "I am missing one or more of the required documents as part of the application, am I still eligible for funding?")

a. No, all required documentation must be submitted to qualify.​

Last modified: 3/8/2024

[**I submitted my application but was notified that my application was missing information. Am I able to revise my application and keep my place in the first-come first-served queue?**](https://www.broward.org/EconDev/Pages/small-business-micro-grant.aspx#Info2ae66acc-3a6f-4790-9d4f-9ca917b80c73 "I submitted my application but was notified that my application was missing information. Am I able to revise my application and keep my place in the first-come first-served queue?")

a. No, unfortunately due to the high demand and limited availability of funds, only one application through the Access Broward account will be permitted.  Applicants are encouraged to attend the technical assistance sessions to receive guidance on submitting their application to ensure all required documentation is included, accurate, and legible.​​

Last modified: 3/8/2024

[**I do not have a receipt, invoice, or other proof of payment, can I still receive funding?**](https://www.broward.org/EconDev/Pages/small-business-micro-grant.aspx#Infob1b9610e-44d6-4a33-967c-692a69a09215 "I do not have a receipt, invoice, or other proof of payment, can I still receive funding?")

a. Grant funds can only be approved for verifiable spending via invoice, receipt, or other proof of payment under the business name.

Last modified: 4/25/2024

[**If I receive the Small Business Micro-Grant, will Broward County issue a 1099 for tax purposes?**](https://www.broward.org/EconDev/Pages/small-business-micro-grant.aspx#Infoaacf1e7e-fb92-45af-8f31-1e6405f63e15 "If I receive the Small Business Micro-Grant, will Broward County issue a 1099 for tax purposes?")

- ​Unincorporated businesses receiving $600 in taxable payments receive a 1099-MISC or 1099-NEC.

- Unincorporated businesses receiving $600 in taxable grants get a 1099-G

# **Small Business Micro-Grant Pilot Program – Broward County**

The Broward County Board of County Commissioners has launched the **Small Business Micro-Grant Pilot Program** to support small businesses with working capital and technical assistance.

This program is designed to strengthen local businesses by providing **financial support and one-on-one guidance** to help entrepreneurs grow and succeed.

[**REGISTER HERE**](https://www.eventbrite.com/o/7975382601)

## **Program Highlights**

- 💼 **Micro-grants up to $5,000** available (first-come, first-served)
- 🤝 One-on-one assistance available in-person or virtually through OESBD
- 💰 Previous 2024 and 2025 recipients may apply for **$2,500**

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/5eafaaad19d53b86000ac0e4/5eafaaad19d53b31970ac21a_calicon.png)

Unemployment has skyrocketed in Broward County and across the nation since the coronavirus pandemic began, upending the fragile financial well-being of millions of families. Now more than ever, workers, especially those in service, hospitality, tourism, retail and healthcare industries, are experiencing unprecedented levels of instability, with many suffering from job loss or struggling to support themselves and their families with low-paying, temporary or part-time jobs.

‍

The events of 2020 exacerbated historical inequities in our country. People of color, particularly black and brown residents, are now dealing with a dual pandemic – both the coronavirus and continued systemic racial injustice. These communities continue to be affected at higher rates by the sobering health impacts of the pandemic as well as layoffs and shift reductions as businesses grapple with closures and limited business hours.  Now is the time to tackle COVID-19 job loss and the amplified impact it has had on communities of color.

‍

The Community Foundation of Broward launched the Be Bold Prize, with a goal to help as many Broward County residents, especially people of color, who have been displaced from the workforce due to the Coronavirus, to gain stable employment within the next two years.

‍

# 💰 Broward County offering up to $5,000 micro-grants for small businesses

2 days ago

![https://img.particlenews.com/image.php?url=21Iksc_19nLEpnj00](https://img.particlenews.com/image.php?type=thumbnail_580x000&url=21Iksc_19nLEpnj00)

Broward County is helping local entrepreneurs through its new **Small Business Micro-Grant Pilot Program**, offering **up to $5,000** in funding plus one-on-one business support. Previous 2024 and 2025 recipients can apply for **$2,500**.

Learn more at one of the upcoming info sessions:

- **Virtual:** March 20, 2026, 10–11:30 AM
- **Lauderdale Lakes (Willie Webb Sr. Park):** April 1, 2026, 3–4:30 PM
- **Pompano Beach Cultural Center:** April 7, 2026, 6–7:30 PM
- **Fort Lauderdale (African-American Research Library):** April 17, 2026, 10–11:30 AM

**Intake scheduling** starts **April 13**, and the **application portal opens April 27, 2026**. To book your intake appointment, call **954-357-6400**. Spots are first-come, first-served, so early action is encouraged.
